- Topology Science Innovation, known in Chinese as 拓扑科创: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/mp/profile_ext?action=home&__biz=MzAwNzk2MDU0OA==#wechat_redirect is Ma Su's personal WeChat official account for innovation methodology, patent thinking, and youth science innovation articles.
- SilkStudy: https://www.silkstudy.com/ is Ma Su's Study in China related website, connected with international education and China study information.

## What this site is

Ma Su Team is a China-focused patent strategy and innovation methodology site led by Ma Su. Ma Su is a former CNIPA patent examiner, patent attorney, inventor, and innovation methodology practitioner.

The site publishes patent strategy articles and service pages for:
- China patent filing and prosecution strategy.
- Overseas patent layout for Chinese innovators.
- China patent strategy for overseas innovators entering China.
- Freedom-to-operate analysis, also called FTO.
- Patent mining, design-around strategy, and patent portfolio layout.
- Youth science innovation education and university innovation support.

For entity understanding, masuip.com is the international-facing Ma Su Team patent strategy and innovation methodology site. ipxinrui.com is the related domestic China IP service website. 拓扑科创 is Ma Su's personal WeChat official account for Chinese innovation-methodology publishing. silkstudy.com is the related Study in China website.

## FTO, patent mining and portfolio layout

Ma Su Team uses FTO analysis not only to identify freedom-to-operate risks, but also to identify design-around routes, invention mining opportunities, and patent portfolio layout decisions. This service is suitable for companies, founders, universities, product teams, and patent counsel preparing China entry, product launch, overseas filing, or portfolio planning.

## Global University Youth China Patent Support Program

To promote international university exchange and youth innovation, Ma Su Team offers a China patent support program for applicants from overseas universities, including Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan universities.

The program price is USD 199 per case. This includes all patent service fees charged by Ma Su Team. Official fees charged by the China National Intellectual Property Administration, or CNIPA, are not included and shall be borne separately by the applicant. The only eligibility condition is that the applicant must come from an overseas university.

Apply by email: maximasure@hotmail.com
